stage: interactive design test harness; no native Android/PadKit integration
sourceOfTruth: Owner's SECOND unlabeled sketch: D-pad central/right; 4 circle action arc on left; horizontal L above, vertical R above-right

anchor.principle: whole constellation rigidly translated relative to safe viewport and thumb-rest point
anchor.hands: right hand uses source sketch; left mirrors relative x, not video/brand/labels
anchor.allowedAdjustment: single 2D Adjust Position knob/drag; translation clamped to safe rectangle; NOT individual button editing
anchor.clampPolicy: if available view below viewport cannot contain original 300dp height plus safe margin, do not shrink hitboxes or silently switch Standard; show an explicit unsupported-layout explanation while preserving saved global choice
anchor.caution: initial grip fractions are prototype heuristics, not ergonomic evidence

geometry.units: dp proxy for collision study ONLY; live Android must measure actual input bounds
geometry.leftHandRule: negate x for all target centers; L/R labels and functional input IDs do not exchange
geometry.dpadVisual: one canonical CARTDECK chamfered cross; schematic may show four arms but one input group
geometry.labeling: four circle positions are P1-P4 in master; avoid committing game system mapping until comparative owner testing

touchResearch.default: touch-down ownership: first valid target captures that pointer until lift/cancel; sliding across other discrete actions does not trigger them
touchResearch.dpad: allow D-pad direction changes while within directional component without firing other buttons
touchResearch.disabledPositions: no input on dormant action circles in two-button systems
touchResearch.multitouch: preserve existing PadKit distinct pointers; no simulated combos/latching
touchResearch.phaseOneDoNotChange: Existing PadKit semantics; HTML harness only visualises the proposed rules pending Daniel review

MegaDrive6/Arcade6.readiness: module unresolved, cannot fit by assertion

DS/3DS.readiness: combined screen leaves less room; design blocked until real viewport measurements

Dreamcast/GameCube/PS2.readiness: future design targets, not gameplay assertions

appearance.style: diagram source is intentionally neutral; cosmetic edition independent from input mapping

validation.targets: two phone widths 320/393dp plus intermediate 360dp; actual Android app window & density must be measured
tasks: false presses while sliding across dormant buttons
validation.doesNotProve: A static/browser prototype cannot validate capacitive behavior or actual PadKit input
